engine: rules baseline only; no LLM decisions
exchangeLabel: Binance, mirrored research dataset; not Kraken live fills

method.fill: next candle open plus adverse slippage
method.exit: rule/risk at observation; no intrabar stop simulation; open positions marked to market
method.winDefinition: closed position with realized profit strictly positive after both fees and slippage
method.confidenceInterval: Wilson binomial 95%; descriptive only, trades can be dependent
method.monthly: Independent freshly funded monthly diagnostics; not one continuous live account
